| [NOTE-024](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-024.md) | Rhode Island Hospital subpoena order | The court quashed a DOJ administrative subpoena (issued under 18 U.S.C. § 3486) for records of minors who received gender-affirming care at Rhode Island Hospital, on three independent grounds: the subpoena lacks a congressionally authorized purpose, it was issued for an improper purpose in bad faith, and it would violate the children's Fourteenth Amendment right to informational privacy. The court also enjoined DOJ from receiving or using any patient-identifying information produced under it. | Skimmed |
